title: Associated module sheaf functor with arbitrary commutative coefficients
statement: Let X be a scheme, R a commutative ring, P a finite group, and c:Y→X a finite etale ULift(P)-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. For an R-linear representation N of P, form the presheaf W↦{s∈LocallyConstant(W×_X Y,N) | s(g y)=g s(y)} on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Restrictions are precomposition, intertwiners act pointwise, and sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] gives an additive functor T_c:Rep_R(P)→Sheaf(X_et,Mod_R). All data are explicitly constructed. The existing ZMod construction is the specialization, followed by its original scalar transport.
